description: A shell script for automating kernel version bumping in OpenWrt, including git operations, configuration management, and version handling.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point handling argument parsing, requirement checks, initialization, kernel bumping, and cleanup.

methods.name: check_requirements
methods.description: Checks for required external commands and reports missing ones.

methods.name: bump_kernel
methods.description: Performs the kernel version bump, including git operations and configuration updates.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes script environment, verifies git state, and sets up variables.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Restores git state and cleans up temporary branches.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the script.

methods.name: _msg
methods.description: Utility function for printing messages with severity levels.
